desc: TWK M3 preset, fixed 0.02 lot, no Nyao gate
keep the TWK signal only if the Nyao score in its direction >= 4.5 (the EA's own threshold)
Nyao score in the signal direction > opposite score
block when the opposite Nyao score >= 4.5
dead-market gate only (ATR ratio >= 0.6 and score > 0)
inverse: keep only signals the Nyao score rejects
